features: Tap a listening pair to preview L then N; no exam or score is created
Replaying the selected pair preserves existing answers
Practice arrows advance words while retaining the selected L/N sound
The studio model ignores repeat taps until both pronunciations finish
Changing words/tabs and hiding the app cancel model playback
Retains progressive recording history and optional update reminders
